shortDescription: Robert Kiyosaki advised buyers on November 20 to wait for Bitcoin’s decline to end before buying. According to Odaily, he plans to increase his holdings after deciding the market has bottomed and said he began buying Bitcoin at $20,000 per coin after the previous decline.
